Overwatch – Season 4: Heroes of Busan Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play Overwatch now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6006aEaTr

Let your teamwork do the talking in Season 4: Heroes of Busan when the new season launches in-game on August 11, 2026 at 11am PT! 

The leader of MEKA Squad is ready for her highly anticipated debut as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon! Take the fight straight to Talon and the Junkers with her close range Plasma Saber and protective Power Barrier. 

D.Mon isn’t the only MEKA Squad pilot showing up this season. During our Shooting Star: My MEKA Mania Event, you’ll get a chance to support your favorite MEKA pilot by completing challenges, earning rewards, and seeing which one is the most popular of them all. 

Battle Passes are getting revamped this season by letting you choose which track to unlock rewards in first. Swap an eligible Legendary reward for something in the curated Swap Pool! 

Competitive is also getting updated with the all-new Emerald Rank, Comp Rank Reset, and the arrival of Team Drives that reward you for teaming up and sticking together as a group. 

And that’s just the beginning! Look out for brand new map reworks, Mythics, the return of a fan-favorite collab, and more. 

#Overwatch #HeroesofBusan
